hypothesis: A small selector can use the frozen full-observation temporal representation to choose among measured movement-mean shifts better than a state-independent frequency control.
input: Concatenate frozen actor base.head input64 and temporal residual input64 at the recorded context. Both cover the original full observed state/history. Normalize128 using TRAIN mean/std with minimum std0.1; clamp [-10,10]. No seed, map, frame number, native pose, outcome or future observation enters selector inputs.
source_frozen: All actor, critic, attention, aim, fire, weapon, std, predictors and source Adam/RNG/checkpoint files unchanged. Only separate offline selector parameters fit. No policy export or ordinary PPO admission.
availability: Use only accepted measured variants; near_stationary is absent if its shift exceeds the predeclared bound2. No unmeasured action receives a negative outcome.
initialization: Final weights zero, final bias control=log495, other biases0. MLP first layer standard initialization. Fixed torch seed20261023 independently for each architecture.
utility: 4*alive_goal + 0.25*kills - received_health_damage/100 - death; labels describe a single observed conditional continuation, not expected Q.
loss: For each TRAIN context, mean softplus(score_loser-score_winner) over all accepted pairs whose utility differs by at least0.05; average contexts equally. Add0.05*(-log P(control)). No development labels enter gradients or normalization.
constant_control: TRAIN mean final probabilities, then renormalize over available actions independently for each context. No development refitting.
harmful: Loses an alive goal, or preserves alive goal and kills with at least5 additional received HP, relative to its own control. Useful comes unchanged from admitted dataset.
selection: If multiple pass, largest development useful-minus-constant, then smaller harmful mass, then fewer parameters. No early stopping/checkpoint search or further fit of failed endpoints.
next_if_pass: Implement a separately versioned native/CUDA categorical movement-mean selector contract before fresh independent game comparison with source, trained, constant and rules. Offline probabilities do not establish a better combat policy; rollout distribution shift remains untested.
next_if_fail: Retain negative results and stop these fits; do not launch quality games or change thresholds. Investigate representation or label variance under a new protocol.
